title: Applicant and business
content:
Eligible entities are proprietorships, partnership firms, LLPs and private limited companies.
Minimum business vintage is 2 years.
Minimum annual turnover of ₹25 lakh as per the latest ITR or GST returns.
GST registration is mandatory.
Applicant age must be between 25 and 65 years at application.
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Eligibility Criteria > Applicant and business

title: Credit score
content: A credit score of 700 or above qualifies for standard processing. A credit score between 650 and 699 is referred for manual review. Applications below 650 cannot be processed.
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Eligibility Criteria > Credit score

title: Loan amount
content: Loan amount ranges from ₹5 lakh to ₹1 crore. For working capital loans the indicative maximum is 50% of annual turnover.
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Eligibility Criteria > Loan amount

title: Pricing and Fees
content:
The interest rate is 14% to 24% per annum on a reducing balance, based on credit score, business vintage and sector. The processing fee is 1% to 2% of the loan amount plus GST.
Prepayment on term loans: 4% of outstanding principal if prepaid within the first 12 months, nil thereafter. Working capital loans have nil prepayment charges.
Late payment charge is 2% per month on the overdue amount.
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Pricing and Fees

title: Documents Required
content:
KYC of the applicant (PAN and Aadhaar), business registration proof, last 12 months bank statements, last 2 years ITR and last 12 months GST returns.
Customers must submit documents only through the secure portal or their relationship manager, never over a phone call.
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Documents Required

title: Process and Timelines
content: Steps: application, document verification, credit assessment, offer, disbursal. A credit decision is given within 3 working days of receiving complete documents. Disbursal happens within 2 working days of offer acceptance.
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Process and Timelines

title: Compliance Rules for Calling
content:
Agents must never guarantee approval and must state that eligibility is preliminary. Agents must not collect OTP, PAN, Aadhaar or bank credentials on calls. Calls are recorded and the customer must be informed. Do-not-call requests must be honoured immediately.
Policy last reviewed on 2025-03-15. Escalation contact: [PERSON], [EMAIL], [PHONE].
section_path: Business Loan Credit Policy > Compliance Rules for Calling

title: What is the ROI on a business loan?
content: The interest rate ranges from 14% to 24% per annum on a reducing balance. The exact rate depends on your credit score, business vintage and sector.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: What is the ROI on a business loan?

title: What documents do I need to apply?
content: You need KYC (PAN and Aadhaar), business registration proof, 12 months of bank statements, 2 years of ITR and 12 months of GST returns. Submit them only through the secure portal or your relationship manager.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: What documents do I need to apply?

title: How long does approval take?
content: You get a credit decision within 3 working days of submitting complete documents, and disbursal within 2 working days after you accept the offer.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: How long does approval take?

title: Will checking my eligibility affect my CIBIL score?
content: The pre-check on this call does not involve a credit bureau enquiry. A bureau enquiry happens only after you submit a formal application with consent.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: Will checking my eligibility affect my CIBIL score?

title: Do I need collateral?
content: Loans up to ₹50 lakh are unsecured. For amounts above that, collateral may be required depending on the credit assessment.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: Do I need collateral?

title: Can I foreclose my loan early?
content: Term loans carry a 4% prepayment charge on outstanding principal in the first 12 months and nil after that. Working capital loans have no prepayment charge.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: Can I foreclose my loan early?

title: Is GST registration compulsory?
content: Yes. GST registration is mandatory for all business loan applicants.
section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > Q: Is GST registration compulsory?

title: Objection: The interest rate is too high
content: Acknowledge the concern. Explain that rates range from 14% to 24% per annum on a reducing balance, and a stronger credit score and longer business vintage bring the rate down. Do not promise a specific rate. Offer a callback from a relationship manager for a personalised quote.
section_path: Objection Handling Playbook > Objection: The interest rate is too high

title: Objection: I need the money urgently
content: Empathise. Explain that a credit decision comes within 3 working days of complete documents and disbursal within 2 working days after acceptance. Do not promise anything faster. Suggest keeping documents ready to speed things up.
section_path: Objection Handling Playbook > Objection: I need the money urgently

title: Objection: I already have a loan from another bank
content: Explain that existing loans do not automatically disqualify the applicant; existing obligations are considered during credit assessment. Offer to continue the pre-check.
section_path: Objection Handling Playbook > Objection: I already have a loan from another bank

title: Objection: I am not comfortable sharing my details
content: Reassure the customer that the pre-check needs only basic business details, and that no PAN, Aadhaar, OTP or bank credentials are ever collected on a call. Offer to proceed with fewer details or arrange a callback.
section_path: Objection Handling Playbook > Objection: I am not comfortable sharing my details

title: Objection: Call me later or I need time to think
content: Respect the request. Offer to schedule a callback at a time of the customer's choice and confirm the number. Do not push further.
section_path: Objection Handling Playbook > Objection: Call me later or I need time to think

title: Objection: I do not want to give collateral
content: Explain that loans up to ₹50 lakh are unsecured; collateral may be needed only for higher amounts.
section_path: Objection Handling Playbook > Objection: I do not want to give collateral
